description: This file is part of Next.js server configuration, handling loading, validation, and default assignment of next.js configuration options, including environment setup, plugin hooks, and internationalization settings.

methods.name: assignDefaults
methods.description: Assigns default values and performs validation on user-provided Next.js configuration object.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and normalizes Next.js configuration based on phase, directory, and optional custom config.

methods.name: isTargetLikeServerless
methods.description: Checks if a given target string corresponds to a serverless-like deployment target.
